Night graveyard: exponential fog, moon sphere with an additive halo sprite built from a CanvasTexture, 26 grass patches, 15 tombstones with arc-capped slabs, a 34-railed iron fence, a dead tree, drifting mist sheets and hands pushing up through the soil.
